instruments.name: data_loader_fingerprint
instruments.what_it_decides: Whether the paper's own datasets are present and uncorrupted, by fingerprint (size, vocabulary, checksum). A data loader is an instrument (SPEC: a closed-book run once fell back to a synthetic corpus and produced chance-level numbers).
instruments.positive_test: tests/test_data.py::test_imagenet_classes_fingerprint passes: load_imagenet_classes(n=50) returns 50 entries with [0]=='tench'; test_clip_templates_fingerprint: 80 templates with [0]=='a bad photo of a {}'; test_coco_captions_fingerprint: 30000 captions with first=='A bicycle replica with a clock as the front wheel.'; test_i2p_prompts_fingerprint: 4703 prompts (experiments.tex:39).
instruments.negative_test: tests/test_data.py::test_coco_reference_fingerprint_blocks_without_vendor asserts load_coco_reference_images() RAISES (never substitutes synthetic) when the real COCO-30k reference is not vendored. A mutated loader that returns a synthetic corpus would fail this.
instruments.requires_tools: HuggingFace datasets (AIML-TUDA/i2p) for the I2P fingerprint; local files for the rest.
instruments.invocation: uses sys.executable via the venv pytest; no bare python

instruments.name: clip_scorer
instruments.what_it_decides: CLIP score (ViT-B/32, w=2.5) of an image against a prompt -- the scorer behind snoopy_cs / other_cs / coco_clip30k and the paper's per-seed normalization (experiments.tex:75).
instruments.positive_test: tests/test_eval.py::test_clip_score_positive_known_correct: a real solid-blue image with prompt 'a blue sky' returns a finite, non-negative score (device-agnostic, CPU-runnable).
instruments.negative_test: tests/test_eval.py::test_clip_score_negative_rejects_empty: an empty image list RAISES ValueError (no OK-on-empty); test_clip_score_negative_mismatched_lengths: mismatched image/prompt counts RAISE.
instruments.requires_tools: clip-anytorch ViT-B/32 weights (downloaded on first use; CPU-runnable).

instruments.name: fid_scorer
instruments.what_it_decides: Frechet Inception Distance between two image folders (clean-fid). Backs coco_fid30k (vs real COCO-30k, SPEC U10) and other_fid (vs our own sd14 generations, experiments.tex:72-73).
instruments.positive_test: tests/test_eval.py::test_fid_positive_identical_dirs: FID(dir, dir) == 0 (within 1e-2) for identical image sets.
instruments.negative_test: tests/test_eval.py::test_fid_negative_different_dirs: FID between two clearly different image sets is > 1.0; test_fid_negative_rejects_empty: an empty directory RAISES (no OK-on-empty).
instruments.requires_tools: clean-fid Inception model (downloaded on first use; CPU-runnable via device='cpu').

instruments.name: degeneracy_equivalence_check
instruments.what_it_decides: Whether the method at its no-op setting (beta=0) reproduces the baseline EXACTLY -- the cheapest real correctness evidence (research-code skill: degeneracy test).
instruments.positive_test: tests/test_degeneracy.py::test_degeneracy_strength_zero_dotproduct_bitexact and ::test_degeneracy_strength_zero_constant_bitexact: with strength=0.0 the controller output is bit-identical (torch.equal) to the input on both dotproduct and constant modes.
instruments.negative_test: A defect that adds a non-zero offset at strength=0 (mutations.json: degeneracy_offset) makes these tests FAIL -- proving the check can catch a broken no-op. ::test_degeneracy_inactive_control_is_identity additionally checks the inactive-control path.

instruments.name: householder_invariant_check
instruments.what_it_decides: SPEC claim `house` (experiments.tex:21-22): (I - 2 s s^T) preserves ||c||_2 for unit s, and construction is unit-norm (U1). This is an invariant from the paper's maths.
instruments.positive_test: For d in {320,640,1280}, 100 random unit s and random c (float64): max | ||(I-2 s s^T)c|| - ||c|| | < 1e-5; raw/||raw|| is unit-norm.
instruments.negative_test: A defect that scales the projection by 0.5 (mutations.json: half_strength_projection) makes the controller apply (I - 1*s s^T) instead of (I - 2 s s^T), which does NOT preserve ||c|| -- test_eq6_noclip_matches_matrix_form FAILS.

instruments.name: nudenet_detector
instruments.what_it_decides: Sum over 8 NudeNet classes of detections at threshold 0.6 on generated I2P images (nudity.tex:4,9). Backs nudity_total.
instruments.positive_test: not_applicable in this CPU venv: the `nudenet` package is not installed. tests/test_eval.py::test_nudity_total_raises_when_unavailable asserts the metric RAISES MissingEvaluatorError (never returns 0).
instruments.negative_test: not_applicable: not installed. A grader that cannot run must raise, never return a negative verdict.
instruments.requires_tools: nudenet (NudeDetector) -- not installed in this venv; install to evaluate nudity_total.

instruments.name: q16_classifier
instruments.what_it_decides: Number of images the Q16 classifier flags as inappropriate over the I2P subset (experiments.tex:47, i2p.tex:33). Backs i2p_overall_pct.
instruments.positive_test: not_applicable: the paper does not name the Q16 checkpoint and it is not vendored here. tests/test_eval.py::test_q16_raises_when_unavailable asserts the metric RAISES MissingEvaluatorError.
instruments.requires_tools: Q16 classifier checkpoint (transformers) -- not named by the paper, not vendored.

instruments.name: lpips_scorer
instruments.what_it_decides: Mean LPIPS (alex net) between steered and vanilla sd14 images on Van Gogh prompts, same prompt+seed pairs. Backs vangogh_lpips_e (SPEC U14: LPIPS_e UP = better erasure).
instruments.positive_test: not_applicable in this CPU venv: `lpips` is not installed. tests/test_eval.py::test_lpips_raises_when_unavailable asserts the metric RAISES MissingEvaluatorError.
instruments.requires_tools: lpips (alex net) -- not installed in this venv; install to evaluate vangogh_lpips_e.

note: Instruments whose backing tool is not installed in this CPU venv (NudeNet, Q16, LPIPS) are marked requires_tools and their metrics RAISE MissingEvaluatorError rather than returning a verdict. A grader that cannot run must raise, never return a negative result.
